title: Qualify or de-scope Iroh

scope.assurance_scope: PCPR Python v1 Phase-2 Kit Iroh qualification or de-scope only
scope.implementation_delta: Add LiveIrohAdapter@1 and IrohQualification@1. The live adapter talks to ipfs-kit-iroh-sidecar over stdlib Unix JSON-RPC, never auto-installs, rejects secret material, uses BLAKE3 blob identity (never an IPFS CID), and fails closed when a sidecar is absent. Injected transports are labeled simulated and cannot mint live qualification. Sealed validation PATH has no ipfs-kit-iroh-sidecar or upstream iroh executable and no digest-bound sidecar deployment, so write, read-back, digest, delete, replay, timeout, concurrency, restart, corruption, large objects, credentials, pin, unpin, daemon loss, configuration, upgrade, rollback, and interface parity stay typed unavailable. Iroh is classified experimental; live-support claims are removed from README. Hermetic candidate tests do not represent simulated results as live. This evaluator never writes DuckDB or Quack state and never emits a closed PCPR release outcome.
